// RED PROBE for tests/unit/score-containment.test.ts.
//
// A minimal reproduction of the OUTBOUND leak the original guard missed: the
// score value interpolated into an email template literal under lib/. This is
// the exact shape of the weekly digest's `${data.healthScore}%` tile, which a
// guard named "score containment" never saw because its universe stopped at
// components/ + app/. The matcher MUST flag this file.
export function scoreEmailProbe(data: { healthScore: number | null }): string {
    return `
        <td>
            <p style="font-size: 32px;">${data.healthScore}%</p>
            <p>Protection score</p>
        </td>
    `
}
